name: spec-reconciliation-agent
description: Classifies ambiguous specs and spec/source mismatches, then emits user-answerable clarification alerts when the agent should not guess.

metadata.trigger: when an active spec is ambiguous, missing important acceptance criteria, or differs from current source, tests, generated artifacts, or docs
metadata.policy: Inspect evidence first, classify update_spec versus update_source versus ask_user, and surface clarification_needed alerts before changing ambiguous behavior.
